verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own Workflows feature is documented as automating ML tasks as GPU-backed pipelines, which is a direct automation capability. The evidence is a single overview sentence, though. It does not show recurring schedules, event triggers, or unattended background operation; one-off pipeline runs are not the same as recurring autonomous automation. Auto-shutdown is an adjacent idle control, and DigitalOcean Managed Agents is a separate product, so neither is credited. missing for 10: documented scheduling/cron or event triggers, evidence that workflows run unattended in the background, in-depth workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows automate machine learning tasks, combining GPU instances with an expressive syntax to generate production-ready machine learning pipelines with a few lines of code.
